blood_crown.name: Bloodstone
blood_crown.description: Critical hits heal the whole party for 5% of the damage dealt.

merchants_eye.name: Merchant's Topaz
merchants_eye.description: Guarantees a Rare+ item every 100 floors climbed.

phoenix_feather.name: Phoenix Ruby
phoenix_feather.description: Revives the first fallen hero once per combat at 40% HP.

dragon_tear.name: Dragon's Tear
dragon_tear.description: +12% Attack and Magic for the whole party.

health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.text: Heals the most wounded hero for 45% HP. Drunk automatically below 30% HP.

mana_potion.name: Mana Potion
mana_potion.text: Restores 50% mana to every hero. Drunk automatically when a hero is out of mana in a boss fight.

fire_bomb.name: Fire Bomb
fire_bomb.text: Blasts every enemy for 300% fire damage. Thrown automatically at bosses.

fortune_scroll.name: Scroll of Fortune
fortune_scroll.text: +50% Gold and double drop chance for 10 floors.

warp_stone.name: Warp Stone
warp_stone.text: Teleports the party to the highest bonfire it has ever reached (great after a fall).

hourglass.name: Hourglass of Haste
hourglass.text: Time flows twice as fast for the party for 10 minutes (while the game is open).

lords_sigil.name: Lord's Sigil
lords_sigil.text: Use to arm it: the next guardian you DEFEAT opens a sealed chest (+2 items, one rarity higher, more gems and crystals). Losing the fight keeps the sigil. Drops from guardians on Torment.

forge._comment: Burn `count` unequipped items of a rarity into one item of the next rarity. Costs scale with item level (item_growth) so the forge stays a sink.

evolve._comment: Evolve: burn `count` bag items of one set, kind and rarity into ONE item of the NEXT set in set_order (same rarity). Class-bound pieces have `class_change` chance to come out as another class.
